raise_justifications.backend/routers/apps.py: POST /v1/apps/enable reads is_setup_completed through _setup_completed_from_response so a developer-controlled body that is non-JSON or not an object returns the intended 400 instead of a 500 (46 prod occurrences Jul 21-28); the guard stays in the route that owns the enable response contract.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/chat.py: The device tool result endpoint must declare a response model or it ships an unmodeled success response the app-client schema inventory refuses; the model itself lives in models/chat.py, so only its import lands here. +13 to reject a result for a call that is not in flight and an oversized payload: the in-flight claim and the size bound live in utils/device_tools.py, and only the HTTP status mapping (404/413) belongs at the route that owns the response contract.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/developer.py: Developer memory create and batch routes must record their accepted write result at the authoritative API boundary; the shared dev-only allowlisted serializer/exporter lives in testing.parity_pack_v0.live_capture.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/mcp_sse.py: The MCP SSE tool handler owns the successful memory-write response boundary; its one shared dev-only allowlisted capture call records accepted memory without duplicating serialization or export logic.
raise_justifications.backend/routers/sync.py: Fresh Sync's daily ceiling remains beside the existing fresh-admission gates, before staged audio or durable worker work is created. Lifecycle-fenced workers are terminalized at this Cloud Tasks boundary so released WAL clients do not retry an owner they no longer own; +2 for the queued-dispatch-lost stale finalization path (#10033).
raise_justifications.backend/routers/users.py: Account-deletion outcome telemetry at the users router boundary for PostHog ownership repair.
